name: bar_table_combo
label: Bar + Table
description: Chart on top, transposed data table underneath, sharing one x-axis. Each measure or table calculation can be placed in the chart, the table, both, or hidden. Reads native Looker column chart and table settings (series colors, labels, types, y-axes, hidden fields, table theme and fonts) so they carry over when switching visualization type.
author: sxia
